title: Morgana has range two
prompt: Stage 4-1, level 7. Morgana 2-star with Rabadon's is your carry. Her attack range is 2, not 4. Elise, Sentinel and Hecarim are your frontline; Cassiopeia and Caitlyn are in the back. Place Morgana.
explanation:
Range decides the row. A range-4 unit in row 3 reaches the enemy frontline without moving. A range-2 unit in row 3 has to walk two hexes forward before her first attack, which is two seconds of not building mana. Put Morgana in row 2, the third row from the front: from there she is one step from being in range, still behind two rows of your own units, and her curse and withering zone land where the fight actually is.

Row 1 puts her in range immediately but in the splash of every frontline cast.
principle: Short-range units sit one row closer than long-range ones. Read the range, then pick the row.
commonMistake: Backlining every caster by habit, then wondering why Morgana casts once per fight.
